questions.question_text: Are students in the Home-Schooling Track required to attend classes physically?
options: No, there is no requirement to attend classes physically
questions.explanation: The ministry documentation clarifies that in the Home-Schooling Track, there is no requirement for students to attend classes physically.

questions.question_text: Who is eligible for the Home-Schooling Track?
questions.explanation: The service documentation states that the Home-Schooling path is open to all nationalities from Grade 7 to Grade 12.

questions.question_text: What is the eligibility requirement for the Home-Schooling Track regarding nationality?
questions.explanation: The Home-Schooling Track is explicitly open to all nationalities from Grade 7 to Grade 12.

questions.question_text: What assessment method is used for Home-Schooling students?
options: Online exams according to Ministry regulations
questions.explanation: Home-schooling students are required to take online exams set by the Ministry of Education to evaluate their progress.

questions.question_text: Which grade levels are supported by the Home-Schooling Track?
questions.explanation: The curriculum support for independent study in the Home-Schooling track covers Grade 7 through Grade 12.

questions.question_text: How is the level assessment conducted for students enrolling in the Home-Schooling track for grades 7, 8, or 9?
options: Via a written interview in July
During the first term exams in April
questions.explanation: Students wishing to enroll in grades 7, 8, or 9 must undergo an assessment during the first term exams of the program in April.

questions.question_text: Are students in the Home-Schooling Track required to be physically present at school?
options: Yes, they must attend all classes daily
No, there is no requirement to attend classes physically
questions.explanation: The Home-Schooling Track allows students to study independently without the need for physical classroom attendance.

questions.question_text: Which students are eligible to enroll in the Home-Schooling Track?
options: Only residents who have lived in the UAE for 10 years
questions.explanation: The track is open to both UAE citizens and residents to support their educational goals.

questions.question_text: How are students assessed in the Home-Schooling Track?
options: By submitting a research project only
Through online exams according to Ministry regulations
questions.explanation: Students in this track must take exams online, adhering to the specific regulations set forth by the Ministry of Education.
